librarySpace.description: The Library is an AI-maintained folder for materials and work: links, videos and ideas you drop in are organized as Markdown, and everything you create lands here too. Defaults to ~/CC-Panes-Library; you can pick another folder.
librarySpace.keptClaudeMd: This folder already has a CLAUDE.md and it was not overwritten. The assistant may not know the Library conventions; merge them from the template manually.
librarySpace.assistantPrompt: You are the Library assistant. Follow the conventions in CLAUDE.md in the current directory: file links, text and images the user sends into uploads/ with the ingest skill, download and transcribe video links with the video-transcribe skill, organize with the organize skill, and write created work to works/. When first opened, greet briefly and say the user can just send you links or ideas.
